newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICAN DAILY PORT, SHIPPING UPDATE FOR AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: MEXICAN DAILY PORT, SHIPPING UPDATE FOR AUG 13.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.

Tropical storm Hilda was spotted at about 726 miles west-southwest of the Socorro island in the Pacific. The storm was drifting west with winds from 45 to 55 knots (51 to 62 miles/86 to 105 km per hour).
The ministry said it expected the storm will continue to move away from the coast in coming days, and warned ships against sailing in the storm's vicinity.
Rains were expected in the Gulf of Mexico in Veracruz and Tabasco states, and also in the Caribbean. Winds in the Caribbean expected from 15 to 20 knots (16 to 22 miles/29 to 38 km per hour).
